def emit_gauge(sink: list[tuple[str, float]], name: str, value: float) -> None:

import unittest
from app.metrics import emit_gauge


class MetricsTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_gauge_records_float(self):
        sink = []
        emit_gauge(sink, "queue_depth", 3)
        self.assertEqual(sink, [("queue_depth", 3.0)])
